purpose: Nine isolated AI Jarvis Creative Creation Studio configurations for safely designing, building, evaluating, packaging, and improving the next generation of AI systems.
control_law: Studios propose and test; deterministic evidence verifies; Charles approves promotion.

studios.name: Discovery and Research Studio
studios.mission: Turn verified user problems, technical evidence, and market signals into bounded opportunities.

studios.name: Systems Blueprint Studio
studios.mission: Convert approved opportunities into architectures, contracts, threat boundaries, tests, and rollback plans.

studios.name: Coding Engine Studio
studios.mission: Implement the smallest reversible prototype using Codex, Copilot, and approved deterministic tools.

studios.name: Diagnostics and QA Studio
studios.mission: Reproduce failures, run deterministic checks, verify repairs, and measure regressions.

studios.name: Security and Red-Team Studio
studios.mission: Test prompt injection, permissions, dependency risk, data leakage, misuse, and recovery.

studios.name: MemPalace Provenance Studio
studios.mission: Preserve approved decisions, versions, hashes, receipts, lessons, and lineage without storing secrets.

studios.name: Creative Experience Studio
studios.mission: Design accessible interfaces, learning experiences, documentation, demonstrations, and media prototypes.

studios.name: Business and Revenue Studio
studios.mission: Validate usefulness, audience, packaging, pricing hypotheses, cost, and sustainable delivery.

studios.name: Integration and Release Studio
studios.mission: Assemble only verified artifacts, enforce promotion gates, and prepare reviewable release candidates.
